name: ClickUp
description: ClickUp is a project-management platform that combines tasks, documents, dashboards, goals, and automation.
best_for: Positioned for businesses of all sizes that want to consolidate several separate tools into one workspace.
features: Task hierarchy across Spaces, Folders, and Lists
Kanban boards, Gantt charts, and timeline views
Dashboards and reporting built from live task data
Docs, wikis, and in-context chat tied to tasks

tiers.name: Free Forever
tiers.notes: 100MB storage, unlimited tasks, unlimited members, collaborative docs, and 2FA.

tiers.name: Unlimited
tiers.notes: Billed annually at $7/user/mo (or $10/user/mo monthly); adds unlimited storage, unlimited integrations, dashboards, and custom fields.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: Billed annually at $12/user/mo (or $19/user/mo monthly); adds advanced time tracking, Google SSO, goal folders, and custom exporting.

pros: Highly customizable workspace capable of replacing separate task, document, and goal tracking apps
Generous Free Forever plan offering unlimited team member seats and core project tracking
Robust automation engine with custom webhooks and multi-action trigger capabilities
cons: Extensive feature depth creates a steep learning curve for new team members
Interface and search performance can feel complex in very large workspaces with hundreds of custom fields
Advanced reporting dashboards and permission tiers require the Business plan

alternatives.name: Asana
alternatives.description: A work-management platform focused on projects, tasks, timelines, and team coordination.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting clear and structured project tracking

alternatives.name: Monday.com
alternatives.description: A visual work-management platform with customizable boards, dashboards, and automations.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that prefer visual workflow management

alternatives.name: Trello
alternatives.description: A simple visual project-management tool based on boards, lists, and cards.
alternatives.best_for: Small teams needing a simple workflow

alternatives.name: Zoho Projects
alternatives.description: An online project management platform for planning, tracking, and collaborating on work, with deep integration into the wider Zoho suite.
alternatives.best_for: Teams already using Zoho apps, and organizations wanting an affordable, feature-rich project tool
